comment: Source read at commit 5458029, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.0. The panel letters the additive modulation FM A and the multiplicative one FM B, which the maker's README calls Additive and Multiplicative; the parameter and port names follow the README. The cutoff CV amount parameter is configured with the range 0.014032 to 0.95 (FMFILT3HR.cpp:149), which are the cutoff clamp limits pasted into the wrong place, so that trim knob cannot be turned fully down or fully up. The cutoff itself is squared before use, so the lower part of the knob's travel covers a small part of the range.
